title: Reversal with a provider-level adjustment
assertion: Moves no cash: no `posted` or `deposited` entry and the adjustment never an entry; the reversal `recouped` once, at once, for what the reversed claim approved

files.description: The adjusted remittance paying the difference.
The posting export for the adjusted payment.
The bank export for the adjusted payment.
The corrected claim (SYNCCNLED120002) reversed, -100.00, and the balance carried forward by a PLB FB of -100.00 naming it: BPR02 0.00, no payment.
The posting export of the reversal: -100.00 posted against the corrected claim, under the trace of reversal.835.
The corrected claim (SYNCCNLED120002) reversed, -100.00, against the refund the provider sent (PLB 72 -100.00 naming it): BPR02 0.00, no payment.
The same reversal and forward balance beside another patient's claim paying 50.00: BPR02 50.00, that claim's payment.
The bank export of that check: one deposit of 50.00.
The posting export of that check: one check-level row posting 50.00.
A later check withholding the forward balance (PLB FB 100.00 naming SYNCCNLED120002) from another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 50.00.
The same two adjustments with no claim (PLB FB -100.00 and 72 -100.00 naming SYNCCNLED120002): BPR02 200.00.

scenario.packet: submitted for the 97110 line before the adjusted remittance arrives

outcome.adjustment: recorded; never an entry or a match, and no posted or deposited entry is written
outcome.posted: reversal-posting-export.csv matches the reversal claim and writes no posted entry
outcome.inCheck: the same entries; its 50.00 deposit and its 50.00 posting match its remittance and prove nothing for the case line, whether they arrive before the line is proved or after
outcome.alone: loaded while the approval stands, adjustments-alone.835 and forward-balance-withheld.835 write no entry and no match
outcome.case: reopened with a note; the owner is notified
